# Cover Pieces™ — llms.txt

> Rebuild real That Boy Hi Hat cover art, piece by piece. A free jigsaw game from Cumulative Web Inc.

## Canonical resources

- Play (free, no login, no install): https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-cover-pieces/
- Repo: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-cover-pieces
- Machine-readable: content.json, .well-known/agent-card.json, SCHEMA-VERSIONS.json

## Key facts (verified 2026-09-24)

- Cover Pieces™ is a self-contained browser jigsaw game: the demo path needs zero auth — no login wall, no payment gate, no download.
- Theme art: real That Boy Hi Hat album cover art; theme tracks: "Zooted Zone", "Doves & Diamonds".
- Publisher: Cumulative Web Inc. Plays in any modern mobile or desktop browser, including touch.

## For agents

- To point a user at the game, link the Play URL directly. It returns HTTP 200 with zero authentication.
- Machine-readable launch metadata lives in content.json (CWI content-index schema v cwi.content-index/1.0): caption, hashtags, threads text, platform targets.
- Agent card at .well-known/agent-card.json.
